title: Can I SURVIVE Duck Chess?
summary: The creator plays chess.com Duck Chess against higher-rated humans (2100-2400), aiming for three wins. Regular chess plus a duck: after each move the mover must place the duck on any empty square; the duck blocks movement and can never be captured. There is no check/checkmate - you win by capturing the king. He uses the duck mainly to stop the opponent's plans (e.g. block castling or a bishop's diagonal), recalls being tricked into losing a queen when the opponent interposed the duck, and wins games 1, 3 and a final game for three wins.
rules: Standard chess pieces and start position.
Each turn: make a normal move, then move the duck to any empty square (it must move to a different square each turn).
The duck blocks all pieces and can never be captured or jumped over (knights can jump it).
No check or checkmate; a king can be left/moved into attack and the game is won by capturing the king.
Stalemated side (no legal move) wins in chess.com duck chess (inferred, not mentioned).
win_condition: Capture the opponent's king. Goal: 3 wins vs higher-rated humans.
